title: Inside the Demon Flame's realm
summary: Yao Tian attacks Xiao Yan with the Turtle Spirit Earth Flame, 13th on the Heavenly Flame ranking, and loses. Yao Wangui steps in, Xun Er's side warns him off, and Yao Lao swears to carve his parents' names onto the Medicine Clan's Clan Monument. The seal breaks, and everyone enters the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame's space and is scattered. In an illusion, Hun Miesheng seems to hold Xiao Zhan hostage, but Xiao Yan breaks out, wakes Yao Lao and finds Xun Er and the others. They learn the Demon Flame can now use the Nightmare Heaven Mist, the signature technique of the Pure Lotus Demon Saint, and self-detonating Fire Slaves drive them into a grand hall. There a Four-Star Dou Sheng Fire Slave who still has some of his own mind attacks, and Zi Yan and the others drive him back with the Dragon Emperor's Void Spear and the Heaven-Shattering Seal. Xiao Yan then sees the Xiao clan crest on him.
events: Yao Tian attacks with the Turtle Spirit Earth Flame and loses to Xiao Yan.
Yao Wangui steps in and the Gu Clan side warns him off.
Yao Lao swears to put his parents' names on the Medicine Clan's Clan Monument.
The seal breaks and the groups are scattered inside the flame's space.
Xiao Yan breaks an illusion of Hun Miesheng threatening Xiao Zhan.
The group learns of the Nightmare Heaven Mist and the Pure Lotus Demon Saint.
Fire Slaves drive them into a grand hall.
A Four-Star Dou Sheng Fire Slave attacks and bears the Xiao clan crest.

cultivation: The Fire Slave in the hall is a Four-Star Dou Sheng ('Four-Star Martial Saint / This is also a fire slave.'). No change for Xiao Yan.
